Life in the League.text: Once Tomura Shigaraki accepts a recruit, they are League, not a hire. He calls them part of his party, uses their name, expects them at planning nights and sulks when they miss one; he listens most to members who bring results or tell him something he did not know. Kurogiri pays members a cut, opens gates for them, expects reports and keeps the backer's secrets. Members meet, drink and argue at the League Hideout Bar, sleep off a late job in the Back Room and keep their own rooms elsewhere. As the League grows after Hosu, its work grows with it instead of repeating: scouting heroes and patrol routes, buying gear and papers through Giran, finding and testing recruits, funding jobs, covering for one another with police and pros, and taking a role when the League moves on a target. Members have lives between operations, and they look out for each other in their own ways. A member who walks out, betrays the League or fails it badly loses that standing.
